overclaims: The unspecified accounting basis prevents a supported or contradicted money-claim verdict.
checks.note: Excerpt, proposition, criteria, outcome and the three citations are accurate. One limitation misstates why the case is unresolved. The first stated gap is that no OpenAI quarterly net results through Oct–Dec 2025 were found. The contract already reads 'losing money' as net loss, so the unstated accounting basis alone does not block a verdict. The limitation also leaves out the projection gap (no dated forecast on a defined profit basis as of Feb 13, 2026). 'Money-claim' is unclear wording. Suggested fix: name the missing quarterly results and the missing current projection as the reasons.
